sn47.36:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || [pe] ||
sn47.36:1.6: Dhammesu dhammanupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || ||
sn47.36:1.8: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
sn47.36:1.9: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā ti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ || || 2.
